feedback: Written before this candidate has raced; no outcome is claimed for it. Evidence from earlier iterations: iteration 3 (wheel_track 0.13, mass 0.6, kp 4.0, kd 0.4) gave 16/20 oval and 7/20 s-bend completions, with steering_oscillation of about 0.30 to 0.31 and 0/20 slalom completions at max_error 0.064. Iteration 4 (mass 0.5, body_length 0.12, wheel_track 0.12, kp 3.8, kd 0.45) reached 20/20 oval and 17/20 s-bend, with slalom oscillation 0.24 and progress 0.43. Iteration 5 (mass 0.45, body_length 0.10, wheel_track 0.115, kd 0.5) gave slalom progress 0.53 and oscillation 0.25, but max_error stayed at 0.064. So yaw response on alternating bends is still the limit, and the agility direction has been net positive. Integration work: I kept the seven-sensor weights at x/0.015, kept ki 0.15 for the motor mismatch, held kp at 3.8, and raised kd to 0.55 because the narrower body speeds up the heading response. The next race decides the next change. If steering_oscillation rises above 0.32 on the s-bend or slalom, the agility gain has outrun the damping, so return wheel_track toward 0.12 m rather than cut inertia further. If slalom max_error stays at or above 0.06 while oscillation stays at or below 0.32, the next lever is still lower yaw inertia, as the iteration 4 to 5 trend showed. If oval or s-bend completions fall below iteration 5 levels, the lighter body has cost stability, so restore mass toward 0.45 kg.
requested_changes: If steering_oscillation rises above 0.32 on the s-bend or slalom: set wheel_track back to 0.12 m, since iteration 4 at 0.12 m kept slalom oscillation at 0.24 while iteration 2 at 0.11 m with kp 4.0 overshot to 0.27 to 0.28.

If slalom max_error stays at or above 0.06 while steering_oscillation stays at or below 0.32: try mass 0.40 kg (the contract minimum) with body_length 0.10 m, since iteration 5 moved slalom progress from 0.43 to 0.53 when yaw inertia fell and the failure persisted at max_error 0.064.
If oval or s-bend completions drop below iteration 5's 20/20 and 18/20: return mass to 0.45 kg, since the 0.45 kg body in iteration 5 completed every oval run and 90% of s-bend runs.
